title: Remote - Global employment infrastructure with fully owned EOR entities
clean_text: Remote (launched 2019) provides global payroll, Employer of Record (EOR), and contractor management infrastructure that other HR platforms also build on, with 100% owned legal entities across 90+ countries for EOR (no deposit required), contractor management support in 190+ countries, and payroll-only services in 40+ countries. It is API-first, offering REST API, webhooks, and CLI for embedding global employment into a company's own product. Remote is particularly useful for companies that want to test hiring in a new country via EOR before deciding whether to set up a local entity, and its fully owned infrastructure model is positioned as offering tighter legal defensibility than hybrid (partner-network) EOR models.

meta.target: companies hiring internationally, including those testing new-country entry before entity setup
